items.title: October 18, 2026
items.summary: Google SecOpsFeatureSpecify whether to reopen closed cases when the grouping is by Source Grouping IdentifierYou can now specify whether Google SecOps reopens closed cases when grouping SOAR alerts by Source Grouping Identifier. When the option is enabled and a new alert is received with a source grouping identifier of a case that was previously closed in Google SecOps, then  Google SecOps reopens the case. For more information, see Configure alert grouping.
